ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, node O is located in the middle, the left end of the upper horizontal branch is A and is connected to O through resistor R1; the right end is B and is connected to O through resistor R2; O is connected downward through resistor R3 to node C, and a ground symbol is drawn next to C, so C is the reference ground node. Reasoning: Take the potential of the ground node as V_C=0. According to the voltage definition, U_CO=V_C-V_O. Given U_CO=-5 V, so -5=0-V_O, solving gives V_O=5 V. The given U_AO=3 V and U_BO=7 V do not need to be used to determine the absolute potential of O.
